title: Cabana Babe Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Cabana Babe is a 1 BR / 1.5 BA / 2 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Nestled right next to the main cottage Cabana Fever beach house is the Cabana Babe, a charming couples retreat.
description_expanded: Description32 NATCHEZ STREET1 Queen, 1 Twin Sleeper Sofa- Sleeps 3A Romantic Seaside Hideaway Just Steps from the GulfCabana Babe is the ultimate Seaside, Florida beach escape for two, perfectly positioned just 174 feet from the private residential beach at Natchez Pavilion and only a 5-minute walk to Seaside’s iconic Central Square. With more than 40 shops and restaurants within walking distance, this intimate retreat invites you to park the car and fully embrace the walkable, bike-friendly charm Seaside is known for.Tucked discreetly behind the main home, Cabana Fever, Cabana Babe is accessed by a sandy footpath and features its own private picket fence entrance, offering a peaceful sense of privacy while keeping you close to all the action.Private Outdoor Spaces for Relaxed Coastal LivingOutside the entrance, two Adirondack chairs create a welcoming spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails under the Florida sky. A small charcoal grill and outdoor shower add extra convenience after a beach day, making it easy to rinse off the sand and enjoy laid-back outdoor meals.Cozy Living with Thoughtful DesignStep inside to a bright, comfortable living area designed with couples in mind. The space features a twin sleeper sofa for one more, aclub chair, large mounted plasma TV, and a dining table for two, creating the perfect setting for relaxed evenings in after a day by the Gulf.Well-Equipped Kitchen & Convenient AmenitiesThe adjacent galley kitchen is compact yet fully equipped, offering a two-burner electric stovetop, small oven, under-counter refrigerator, microwave, sink, and Keurig coffee maker—everything you need for simple meals or beach-day snacks. A half bathroom and a stackable washer and dryer are conveniently located on the main level.Serene Upstairs Primary Suite with Private BalconyUpstairs, the cheerful primary queen bedroom provides a peaceful retreat with a chaise lounge, dresser, custom built-in storage, and flat-screen TV. The ensuite bathroom features a single vanity and walk-in shower for added comfort. Step outside onto your private open-air balcony, where custom bench seating is nestled among palm trees—an idyllic spot to enjoy the ocean breeze and the gentle sounds of nearby waves.An Effortless Seaside Getaway for TwoCabana Babe is perfectly suited for couples seeking a romantic, walkable Seaside vacation rental with unbeatable proximity to the beach and town center. Whether you’re strolling to sunset dinners, biking through Seaside’s charming streets, or unwinding on your private balcony, this cozy coastal cottage offers an unforgettable stay in the heart of 30A.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES480 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space174 feet (1-minute walk) to beach access at Natchez Pavilion; largest private residential beaches on 30AOutdoor shower, ideal after a day on the beachPeacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughoutAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOnly 1 parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets allowed STR23-001909
